iti92:2.1: (Tik. V.) Saṅghāṭikaṇṇe ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhu gahetvā piṭṭhito anubandho assa pāde pādaṃ nikkhipanto so ca hoti abhijjhālū kāmesu tibbasārāgo vyāpannacitto paduṭṭhamanasaṃkappo muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākatindriyo, atha kho so ārakā va mayhaṃ ahañca tassa. Taṃ kissa hetu? Dhammaṃ hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu na passati dhammaṃ apassanto na maṃ passati.
iti92:3.1: Yojanasate ce pi so bhikkhave bhikkhu vihareyya, so ca hoti anabhijjhālū kāmesu na tibbasārāgo avyāpannacitto appaduṭṭhamanasaṃkappo upaṭṭhitasati sampajāno samāhito ekaggacitto saṃvutindriyo, atha kho so santike va mayhaṃ ahañca tassa. Taṃ kissa hetu? Dhammaṃ hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu passati, dhammaṃ passanto maṃ passatīti. Anubandho pi ce assa mahiccho va vighātavā | ejānugo
iti92:4.1: anejassa nibbutassa anibbuto | giddho so vītagedhassa passa yāvañca ārakā ||
iti92:5.1: Yo ca dhammam-abhiññāya dhammam-aññāya paṇḍito | rahado va nivāto ca anejo vupasammati ||
iti92:6.1: Anejo so anejassa nibbutassa ca nibbuto | agiddho vītagedhassa passa yāvañca santike ti ||3||
